description.en: Manage archived and unarchived chats with search, previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, selected actions, a Recycle Bin, storage and retention, origins and branches, and automatic residual chat checks.
description.zh: 管理已归档与未归档会话，支持搜索、预览、标签备注、工作区归档、ZIP 备份、选择操作、回收站恢复、空间与保留策略、来源分支和自动残留会话检查。
